utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I don't have enough info to judge the repair drive. What do you think?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven't really gotten the full story on it yet. Might ask around at the grocery store later.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Mind if I come along? I'm curious too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Need to borrow any tools for the repair drive? I've got a good set of wrenches.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wrenches? Uh, yeah, maybe. I think I left mine out in the rain last week.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Well, you're in luck—mine are dry and ready to go. Just grab 'em when you need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Pia, have you heard about the repair drive? I think they're still collecting broken electronics down at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, I've seen the flyers around. Are they still accepting items this late in the week?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I'm not totally sure, actually. I just saw the flyer last Tuesday, so maybe you should call ahead to check.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I heard you're organizing a repair drive — need any tools or a hand sorting things out?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam! I'm still figuring out the inventory, but I might need some extra wrenches. Want to help me sort donated items this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I'd be happy to help sort this weekend. I'll bring my wrench set in case you need it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, are you coming to the repair drive this weekend? It's going to be a great chance to fix things up and meet the neighbors!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I might stop by for a bit, but I can't stay long.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's perfect! Even a little help goes a long way — I'll save you a spot near the coffee station.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo, great to see you! Are you ready to coordinate the supplies for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, I have a list ready. Let's go over it quickly.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, let's sit down and look it over together—I want to make sure we don't miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: The repair drive, is that the one you mentioned needing special calibration?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that's the one — it's a bit finicky with the alignment, so I'll probably be a little late to the garage.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, I'll make sure the garage tools are ready for that alignment job. Need me to prep anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Mara, do you think the repair drive will interfere with the school pickup schedule tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, I don't think it should—Tom said they'll start after 3 PM, so pickup should be fine.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That's a relief, I was worried I'd have to find backup for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Jules, I heard from someone down the street that the repair drive is happening this weekend—do you know if that's true?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I think I heard something about that too, but I'm not sure of the exact date—maybe we should check with the community board?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's a good idea, I'll swing by the community board later and see if there's a flyer posted.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Kira, what's this about a repair drive? I'm in a bit of a rush, just catch me on the basics.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? Are you sure you heard right? I haven't seen any official notice about it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, maybe I mixed it up with something else. I just heard someone mention it in passing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Did you hear about the repair drive? I'm thinking of signing up, but I'd want to know more about it first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I saw a flyer about that... or maybe it was a lost cat poster. What's it about again?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: From what I heard, it's a community effort to fix up broken household items instead of tossing them. I thought you might know someone running it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Cleo, are we still on for the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, I've already packed up some spare tools and a few extra rolls of duct tape — can't hurt to be prepared.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I'll let the others know we're all set for Saturday then.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Rey, heard you're organizing a repair drive. How's that going?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, just trying to help folks fix things instead of tossing them. It's coming along slow but steady.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to hear, I've got a busted toaster and a wobbly chair if you're still taking items.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I heard something about that... what's it for again?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It's for fixing up old bikes and lawn mowers around the neighborhood! We're meeting at the community center next Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Next Saturday morning, you say? I'll try to remember that — maybe I should write it down somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sorry, Leo, you were saying something about a repair drive? I zoned out for a second.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: The repair drive is this Saturday at the community center. Bring any broken appliances.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, Saturday... wait, this Saturday? I have a thing then, maybe.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got a couple spare wrenches if you need 'em, Eli.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Much obliged, Gus. I do like to have my own tools ready, but those spares might come in handy if someone forgets theirs.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Well, you know me, I always keep a few extras in the truck just in case.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, Quinn, I was just thinking about the repair drive — are we still on for Saturday morning at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Mara! I've already spread the word to half the block — we're going to have a great turnout.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's wonderful, Quinn! I'll bring my toolbox and some extra coffee.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, Opal! I heard you're organizing a repair drive for the community center. How's that going?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It's coming along nicely—I've got bins labeled for electronics, textiles, and small appliances down in the basement storage room.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's fantastic, Opal! I've got a few neighbors who might want to drop off some old laptops and toasters—I'll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Cleo, I wanted to check in with you about the repair drive — we still need a few more volunteers to help patch up the community center's roof.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've got some extra roofing nails and tarps in my shed if that helps, Rosa. Haven't had many folks sign up yet, though.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful, Cleo — every bit counts! Let me know when I can swing by to pick those up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, what's this about a repair drive? I haven't heard much about it yet.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's a community effort to fix up the old playground equipment. You interested in helping out?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, that sounds great! I'd love to help, but can you tell me more about what needs to be done?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey, Faye. The drive about the repairs—did it say if they're starting next week or the one after?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I think it's next week, but let me double-check the flyer they sent home.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Okay, just let me know when you find out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Need a hand with that repair drive? I'm pretty handy with tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You sure you know what you're doing? That drive's trickier than it looks.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I've fixed plenty of drives before—just point me at the problem and I'll take a look.
